premerge_pr.body:
W009 derives exact CUT differences, OD/POLY channels and spatial S/D terminal regions from authenticated W008 input. It preserves drawn records, raw occupancy and provenance, with immutable region contracts and canonical wire validation.

Includes the reviewed IPMR-01/FXR-01 repairs: unexpected failures retain their original exception identity across the complete nested geometry/capture/readback decode chain, while malformed values are explicitly rejected and collections are validated and stored from one snapshot. Independent premerge and repair review findings are closed.

Validation: Python 3.12 complete v2 1149 passed; Python 3.10 affected scope 988 passed (remaining parser units not rerun); both strict typing runs cover 44 modules; new wheel/sdist and two clean outside-source installations pass. PM additionally reran 235 repair regressions, the 99/99 exception matrix, typing and 41 independent boundary checks; final source/package/evidence identities match. Details: docs/tasks/W009/ipmr01-pm-receipt.md.

Complete technology coordinates, physical connectivity/body/device extraction, annotation, baseline/no_change and Stage 6 remain subsequent work. PM will record final task acceptance after main integration and combination verification.
